parameters.query:
SELECT 
    pr.callid, 
    pr.transcript_s3_url,
    pr.stt_processed,
    c.*
FROM public.calls c 
JOIN public.pipe_response pr ON c.callid = pr.callid 
WHERE c.stt_processed = true 
  AND pr.stt_processed = true
  AND pr.llm_processed = false 
  AND c.skip = false
ORDER BY c.created_at ASC 
LIMIT 30;

INSERT INTO public.llm_analysis (
  callid, sentiment, topic, significant_term, general_value,
  general_experience, email_inquired, positive_comment_passed_sale,
  negative_comment_passed_sale, price_negotiated, customer_addressed_politely,
  conversation_fun, service_advantages_mentioned, other_platforms_mentioned,
  sale_outcome, sale_value_scale, asked_if_commenters_known,
  high_profile_advantages_mentioned, llm_error_message,analysis_method
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.callid }}',
  '{{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.sentiment }}',
  '{{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.topic }}',
  '{{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.significant_term }}',
  '{{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.general_value }}',
  '{{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.general_experience }}',
  {{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.email_inquired === 'true' ? 'true' : $('Format LLM Response').item.json.email_inquired === 'false' ? 'false' : 'null' }},

  {{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.negative_comment_passed_sale === 'true' ? 'true' : $('Format LLM Response').item.json.negative_comment_passed_sale === 'false' ? 'false' : 'null' }},
  {{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.price_negotiated === 'true' ? 'true' : $('Format LLM Response').item.json.price_negotiated === 'false' ? 'false' : 'null' }},
  {{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.customer_addressed_politely === 'true' ? 'true' : $('Format LLM Response').item.json.customer_addressed_politely === 'false' ? 'false' : 'null' }},
  {{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.conversation_fun === 'true' ? 'true' : $('Format LLM Response').item.json.conversation_fun === 'false' ? 'false' : 'null' }},
  {{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.service_advantages_mentioned === 'true' ? 'true' : $('Format LLM Response').item.json.service_advantages_mentioned === 'false' ? 'false' : 'null' }},
  {{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.other_platforms_mentioned === 'true' ? 'true' : $('Format LLM Response').item.json.other_platforms_mentioned === 'false' ? 'false' : 'null' }},
  '{{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.sale_outcome }}',
  {{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.sale_value_scale ?? 'null' }},
  {{ $('Format LLM Response').item.json.asked_if_commenters_known === 'true' ? 'true' : $('Format LLM Response').item.json.asked_if_commenters_known === 'false' ? 'false' : 'null' }},

  significant_term = EXCLUDED.significant_term,
  general_value = EXCLUDED.general_value,

  conversation_fun = EXCLUDED.conversation_fun,
  service_advantages_mentioned = EXCLUDED.service_advantages_mentioned,
  other_platforms_mentioned = EXCLUDED.other_platforms_mentioned,
  sale_outcome = EXCLUDED.sale_outcome,
  sale_value_scale = EXCLUDED.sale_value_scale,
  asked_if_commenters_known = EXCLUDED.asked_if_commenters_known,

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.pipe_response
SET

  response = '{{ $json.response }}',
  calltext = NULL,
  note = '{{ $json.note }}',

  updated_at = '{{ $json.llm_processed_at }}',
  llm_processed = {{ $json.llm_processed }},
  llm_error = 'No error',

  analysis_s3_url = '{{ $json.analysis_s3_url }}'
WHERE callid = '{{ $json.callid }}';

INSERT INTO call_analysis (
    callid, sentiment, topic, significant_term, general_value, general_experience,
    email_inquired, positive_comment_passed_sale, negative_comment_passed_sale,
    price_negotiated, customer_addressed_politely, conversation_fun,
    service_advantages_mentioned, other_platforms_mentioned, sale_outcome,
    sale_value_scale, asked_if_commenters_known, high_profile_advantages_mentioned,
    coordination_confidence, agent_conflicts_resolved, language_detected,
    analysis_method, agent_count, llm_error_message,

    calltype, ext, phn, url, call_direction, recording_url, skip_reason, skip, h_agent,
    s3_uploaded, stt_processed_calls,

    agent, response, calltext, note, transcript_s3_url, analysis_s3_url,
    llm_processed, stt_processed_pipe, llm_error_pipe
)
WITH UniqueLLM AS (
    -- llm_analysis tablosundaki yinelenen kayıtları temizler.
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY callid ORDER BY COALESCE(updated_at, created_at, '1970-01-01') DESC) as rn
    FROM llm_analysis
),
UniquePipeResponse AS (
    -- pipe_response tablosundaki yinelenen kayıtları temizler.
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY callid ORDER BY COALESCE(updated_at, created_at, '1970-01-01') DESC) as rn
    FROM pipe_response
)
SELECT
    la.callid, la.sentiment, la.topic, la.significant_term, la.general_value, la.general_experience,
    la.email_inquired, la.positive_comment_passed_sale, la.negative_comment_passed_sale,
    la.price_negotiated, la.customer_addressed_politely, la.conversation_fun,
    la.service_advantages_mentioned, la.other_platforms_mentioned, la.sale_outcome,
    la.sale_value_scale, la.asked_if_commenters_known, la.high_profile_advantages_mentioned,
    la.coordination_confidence, la.agent_conflicts_resolved, la.language_detected,
    la.analysis_method, la.agent_count, la.llm_error_message,

    c.calltype, c.ext, c.phn, c.url, c.call_direction, c.recording_url, c.skip_reason, c.skip, c.h_agent,
    c.s3_uploaded, c.stt_processed AS stt_processed_calls,

    pr.agent, pr.response, pr.calltext, pr.note, pr.transcript_s3_url, pr.analysis_s3_url,
    pr.llm_processed, pr.stt_processed AS stt_processed_pipe, pr.llm_error AS llm_error_pipe
FROM
    (SELECT * FROM UniqueLLM WHERE rn = 1) la
JOIN
    calls c ON la.callid = c.callid
LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT * FROM UniquePipeResponse WHERE rn = 1) pr ON la.callid = pr.callid
LEFT JOIN
    call_analysis ca ON la.callid = ca.callid
WHERE
    ca.callid IS NULL
